hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; ok=1; [ "$(git config core.hooksPath)" = .githooks ] || ok=0; for h in pre-commit commit-msg pre-merge-commit; do [ -x .githooks/$h ] || ok=0; done; git ls-files -s .githooks | grep -qv '^100755 ' && ok=0; [ $ok = 1 ] || echo '警告：提交闸门没装或失效（core.hooksPath 应为 .githooks、.githooks/ 下三个钩子须可执行且索引模式为 100755），此时提交不会被拦。修复：git config core.hooksPath .githooks；索引模式：git update-index --chmod=+x .githooks/*。见仓库工作须知 §7。'
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { git log -1 --format='HEAD %h %s'; git status -sb | head -20; }; echo '压缩或恢复后先重读当前工作项。'
